svg.title: An update moves more than one page
svg.desc: An eight-page block contains one target and seven neighbors. Copy seven live neighbors out, erase the original block, write the updated target, copy seven neighbors back, and erase the temporary block. Measured driver calls: 37 reads, 15 writes, two erases. Labels use outlined Noto Sans.

g.aria-label: An update moves more than one page
g.title: An update moves more than one page

g.aria-label: The physical page number stays fixed; neighboring live pages travel through a temporary block.
g.title: The physical page number stays fixed; neighboring live pages travel through a temporary block.

g.aria-label: 37 driver reads / 15 page writes / 2 block erases
g.title: 37 driver reads / 15 page writes / 2 block erases

g.aria-label: The CLI prints 14 reads here; its counter omits validation and empty-page probes.
g.title: The CLI prints 14 reads here; its counter omits validation and empty-page probes.
